name: The Jaded Hearts Club
intro: The Jaded Hearts Club is a rock supergroup and covers band consisting of Miles Kane (of the Rascals and Last Shadow Puppets), Nic Cester (of Jet), Matt Bellamy (of Muse), Jamie Davis (of former member Graham Coxon's former label Transcopic) and Sean Payne (of the Zutons).
